PENDAFTARAN PENGAMBILAN PERAJURIT MUDA TENTERA DARAT (PM TD) LELAKI SIRI 208 TAHUN 2026 SECARA ATAS TALIAN BERMULA 3 OGOS SEHINGGA 3 SEPTEMBER 2026

1.  Golongan belia lelaki yang berminat untuk menyertai Tentera Darat Malaysia, pendaftaran Pengambilan PM TD Lelaki Siri 208 Tahun 2026 dibuka bermula 3 Ogos sehingga 3 September 2026.

a. Calon serta Ibu atau Bapa mestilah WARGANEGARA MALAYSIA.
b. Ketinggian Minima: Lelaki - 157 cm.
c. BMI - 18.0 hingga 28.0.
d. Umur - Mestilah tidak kurang dari 18 tahun dan tidak melebihi 30 tahun bagi calon lelaki pada 30 November 26.

a. SPM - Lulus BM dan Sejarah.
b. SVM - PNGK Akademik 2.0 ke atas.

5.  Sila layari Portal Rasmi Tentera Darat di www.army.mil.my (Kerjaya/Permohonan) untuk maklumat lanjut.

BUDGET HOTEL BECOMES A PORT FOR FOREIGNERS TO PROSTITUTE

The Malaysian Immigration Department (JIM) conducted an operation on August 23, 2026, at three locations around Seremban, Negeri Sembilan.

Seven local residents were detained for allegedly engaging in immoral activities and espionage, while other foreigners were detained for allegedly engaging in activities.

The investigation found that the activities were carried out by placing foreign women at hostels or budget hotels on a daily or weekly basis. These hostels were believed to be managed and controlled by local and foreign citizens who acted as 'captains' or managers. The foreign women were believed to offer sex services for a fee of RM50 per service to customers. The operation is believed to have been operating for about a year, with a structured management structure in place to ensure the operation continued and was estimated to generate a profit of around RM540,000 per year.
